name: Yuri no Hana Gakuen Ryou ~Soushun no Kanon~
original_name: 百合の花学園寮 ～早春のカノン～
source: Set in their school dormitory, a sad story of a forbidden love hidden in a girl's heart.... The story takes on the 3 protagonists' perspectives as they each become entangled in the forbidden love triangle.
translation: Set in their school dormitory, a sad story of a forbidden love hidden in a girl's heart.... The story takes on the 3 protagonists' perspectives as they each become entangled in the forbidden love triangle.
